rag.title: Knowledge Base
rag.desc: The knowledge base combines vector, BM25, and fuzzy retrieval, with an optional reranker to improve result ordering.
rag.modelSectionDesc: The embedding model enables semantic retrieval. The reranker is optional, and local lexical retrieval remains available without either model.
rag.indexStatusDesc: Review the current index size. Rebuild after changing models, chunking, or excluded paths.
rag.basicSettingsDesc: AI decides when other notes are useful; you can tune how deeply it searches and how broadly it matches.

article.title: Articles
article.desc: Include Markdown articles in semantic knowledge search.

record.title: Records
record.desc: Index individual records, OCR, transcripts, and existing metadata.

canvas.title: Canvases
canvas.desc: Index canvas node text and explicit connections.

rag.globalSemanticSearchDesc: Add related results after typing pauses. Local exact search remains available when disabled.
rag.purgeDisabledConfirm: Delete local vectors for all disabled source types? Re-enabling them will require rebuilding.
rag.automaticSearchTitle: Allow AI to reference other notes
rag.automaticSearchDesc: When a question depends on your records, AI finds relevant notes automatically. It skips search for general questions or when the current note is sufficient.

fast.title: Fast
fast.desc: Search at most once to minimize response time.

balanced.title: Standard
balanced.desc: Search up to twice for a balance between speed and cross-note discovery.

deep.title: Deep
deep.desc: Search up to three times for comparisons, history, and cross-note synthesis.

rag.presetDesc: Presets only adjust result count and thresholds.
rag.settingsDesc: By adjusting parameters, you can more precisely control the retrieval effect of the knowledge base.
rag.deleteVectorConfirm: Clear the vector and BM25 indexes? Your notes will not be deleted, and local fuzzy retrieval will remain available.
rag.enableDesc: Enabling it will make AI search your notes when answering questions, providing more accurate answers.
rag.chunkSizeDesc: The maximum number of characters for text chunking. Larger chunks may contain more context, but will increase vector calculation complexity.
rag.chunkOverlapDesc: The number of overlapping characters between text chunks. Larger overlaps can maintain context continuity.
rag.resultCountDesc: The number of relevant context chunks ultimately sent to AI. More chunks provide more information but may introduce noise.
rag.similarityThresholdDesc: Filters low-similarity vector results only. It does not affect BM25 or fuzzy retrieval. Higher values are stricter.
rag.rerankThresholdDesc: When a reranker is enabled, filter low-relevance results instead of filling the result limit with noise.
rag.rerankThresholdDisabledDesc: No available reranker is configured. Local fusion scoring is used and this threshold has no effect.
rag.excludedPathsDesc: Enter one folder or path prefix relative to the knowledge base root per line. Rebuild the index after saving.
rag.excludedPathsInvalid: Use safe paths relative to the knowledge base root. Absolute paths and .. are not supported.
rag.advancedSettingsDesc: Tune chunking and filtering thresholds. Rebuild after changing chunk settings.
rag.diagnosticDesc: Enter a real question to inspect retrieval channels, fusion scores, and ranks before and after reranking.
rag.diagnosticNoResults: No results matched the current thresholds.
rag.dangerZoneDesc: Clear derived retrieval indexes without deleting notes.
rag.deleteVectorHint: Clearing vector and BM25 indexes keeps local fuzzy retrieval available. Rebuild to restore semantic retrieval.
rag.topPDesc: Top P parameter controls the diversity of text generated by the model. Smaller values make the output more deterministic, while larger values make it more diverse.
